neighbours.label: women or widows named as a vulnerable or dependent group (women and children, a widow left with children, widows and orphans); men, soldiers or other groups in the same slot stay low
fire: The refugees, mostly women and children, waited at the border for days.
The famine hit women and young children hardest.
When the miner was killed, his widow received a small pension.
Each winter the church collected food for widows in the parish.
Among the hostages were several women and an infant.
Rebels attacked the village, killing women and old men.
She was left a widow at twenty-five with two babies.
The shelter offers beds to women fleeing violence at home.
quiet: The refugees, mostly young men, waited at the border for days.
The famine hit farmers and herders hardest.
When the miner was killed, his brother received a small pension.
Each winter the church collected food for families in the parish.
Among the hostages were several soldiers and a pilot.
Rebels attacked the village, killing cattle and goats.
She was left a millionaire at twenty-five with two houses.
The shelter offers beds to travellers stranded by snow.
